verdict.rationale: Aleph is an AI-native FP&A SaaS platform, so a no-training privacy guarantee or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only encryption, access permissions, audit logs, and data removal on trial cancellation; none of these says customer data is excluded from AI model training or that users can opt out. The 'train your agents' wording refers to configuring mapping agents with prompts, not to controlling model training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
